_note: S182 — the lightning hub's 24-frame damage ramp, built by scripts/build-sheet-atlas.mjs.
The SOURCE is the owner's 8x3 contact sheet read in reading order as one continuous ramp,
frame 1 pristine to frame 24 rubble. The OUTPUT is 2 rows of 12, which is the shape the rest
of the pipeline is built around (ART_PIPELINE.md: 'it needs 12 frames'). states[] is the only
grid{} is an ASSERTION against the detected rules, never the source of the cell bounds — the
cells on this sheet are 254..184 wide and 270..285 tall, so a uniform 1908/8 stride would clip
ticksPerFrame 2 is HUB_RAMP_TICKS_PER_FRAME in src/render/structureRamp.ts and is pinned
against this file by structureRampAtlas.test.ts. 24 frames x 3 = 72 ticks = 1.2 s, which is the
owner's R182-D: 'if he destroys a whole structure in one hit, within like one second it looks
like a whole structure got destroyed.'
